metadata.title: Short-term solar eclipse predictions using Euclidean geometry and dynamical systems
metadata.abstract: We propose a computationally inexpensive algorithm to determine whether an opaque spherical body eclipses a luminous one, using only classical geometrical tools. We apply this method to the Sun-Earth-Moon system and predict solar eclipses, including their type, beginning, and duration, using the three-body problem. For predictions over a one-year period, the resulting errors are in the order of minutes.

analysis.progressType: 日食的几何动力学算法
analysis.workSummary: 以经典球面遮挡几何和三体动力学构造低成本日食预测，给出类型、起始及持续时间；一年窗口中的误差为分钟量级。
analysis.breakthrough: 用简单几何模型获得短时日食预测。
analysis.limitations: 精度结论限于一年预测窗口，不等同高精度星历。
